title: Confusing error message about native abstract class and .new()
body:
### Tested versions

v4.6.stable.official [89cea1439]

### System information

unrelated

### Issue description

Hi,

I was creating a class containing some properties, and I knew it was going to be a StaticBody3D, but I wanted to allow the script to be attached to other collider type in the future, so I choose CollisionObject3D.

And there is this error: Class "MyClassExtendingTheNativeClass" cannot be constructed as it is based on abstract native class "CollisionObject3D".

Which is hard to understand:
* is it forbidden to extend an abstract native class?
=> this is not indicated in the native class, nor in the [doc](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/scripting/gdscript/gdscript_basics.html#abstract-classes-and-methods); it's also not indicated in the editor when opening the class extending the abstract native class
=> it's only indicated when attempting MyClassExtendingTheNativeClass.new()
* Am I supposed to create the appropriate `@abstract` methods?
=> the editor does not indicate there are such things; it does indicate it if it's a script abstract class

```python
extends CollisionObject3D
class_name MyClassExtendingTheNativeClass

# elsewhere

# this raises an error in the editor
var my_instance= MyClassExtendingTheNativeClass.new()
```

(I needed the new() to fix another error)

I don't really need it, but someone might, and it's confusing.

In the doc, there is a mention of, and it's not the error I'm talking about, "NATIVE_METHOD_OVERRIDE", which should, and is not, link to an explanation maybe, and, if there is a code name for the error I'm talking about in this issue, I don't see it.

Possible duplicates: there are other people having this issue, but not like this, and some are closed

### Steps to reproduce

```python
extends CollisionObject3D
class_name MyClassExtendingTheNativeClass

# elsewhere

# this raises an error in the editor
var my_instance= MyClassExtendingTheNativeClass.new()
```
